scope: Unmodified raw ExpertKnowledge.search only; excludes chat query expansion, claim-source validation and model generation.

construction.author: Project-maintainer authored gold relevance labels from the reviewed corpus
construction.reclassified_after_baseline: 2026-11-11: results and missed queries were disclosed to the ranker author, who is improving canonicalization and context disambiguation. This set must no longer be called held-out.
construction.freeze_policy: Queries and gold relevance labels remain frozen. The original baseline was run before ranker changes; subsequent changes may use this development set, but must be evaluated on a separately undisclosed holdout. Do not rewrite gold labels to improve scores. Report misses.
construction.coverage: Chinese and English paraphrases, low-overlap synonyms, multi-facet questions, and irrelevant or out-of-corpus questions with tempting lexical overlap.
construction.limitation: Small manually labelled convenience sample; not an independent human study, BEIR run, statistical generalization claim, or semantic-entailment benchmark.

metric_definitions.recall_at_k: Mean over relevant queries of |top-k IDs intersect gold IDs| / |gold IDs|.
metric_definitions.mrr_at_k: Mean reciprocal rank of the first gold ID among the first k results; zero when absent. Relevant queries only.
metric_definitions.all_gold_hit_rate_at_k: Fraction of relevant queries for which every labelled ID is in top-k; useful for multi-topic queries.
metric_definitions.facet_recall_at_k: Mean fraction of required claim facets covered by the retrieved documents' supports.
metric_definitions.no_hit_abstention_rate: Fraction of no-hit queries returning an empty list; false-positive rate is its complement.
metric_definitions.scores_are_not: Answer accuracy, confidence, citation entailment, market validation, or prediction success.

limitations: Gold relevance is manually authored by a project maintainer, not independently adjudicated.
Split role and prior exposure are recorded in construction; this is not a blind external benchmark.
No answer accuracy, source entailment, numeric correctness or prediction performance is measured.
Facet coverage is a reviewed metadata mapping, not an automatic proof that an answer is entailed.
Known misses and incidental lexical matches are retained; no ranker changes were made from this evaluation.
